title: Solomon's Wisdom Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Solomon’s Wisdom Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Solomon Bible crossword: the dream at Gibeon, the two mothers and the sword, the temple, and the queen of Sheba. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Offered anything he asks for, a young king asks for an understanding heart to judge a great people. Solomon's Wisdom covers what that looked like in practice — the two women and the living child, the temple seven years in the building, the throne of ivory, and a queen who came a long way to ask hard questions and went home with no more spirit in her.
The clues draw on Proverbs as well as Kings, since that is where the wisdom itself is written down. The closing verse is the sentence Proverbs opens with.

clues.text: What he asked God for instead of riches
Queen who came to prove him with hard questions
He was seven years in building it
“The fear of the LORD is the beginning of ___”

verseText: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
